events.title: A new hand enters the shared world
events.body: The assistant has added a live change-reception layer. GEEHUB now reads the assistant-touch feed, emits a TRANSFORM event into the shared interaction bus, lets the member-reaction and consequence systems respond, and renders a reaching hand through the interaction orbit. This event is the first visible arrival of that code change.
events.outcome: A repository change becomes a world event with a visible spatial response and downstream character reactions.
